readme.text: This workbook is a living “lay of the land” board for working directors: lane/scale/tonal DNA, track record, and near-term commitments.

1) Start in UNIVERSE to get the real lay of the land (400+ working directors). Filter by Tier/Lane/Scale.
2) Use DIRECTORS for deeper vetted profiles (your “Board A” shortlist).
3) PROJECTS_NEXT is a flat list of announced upcoming projects (use it to sanity-check availability).
4) ACTOR_MATRIX helps you map actor↔director repeat relationships.
5) DASHBOARD gives quick counts (DIRECTORS + UNIVERSE).

New fields (2026-01-29 update)
• Budget bands: use BudgetBandTypical (+ optional low/high) to bucket directors by the budget range they can credibly carry.
• Last-3 performance: Film1–Film3 columns capture the last 3 director credits with Domestic/International/Worldwide grosses (source: The Numbers). Populate TheNumbersURL first, then fill/refresh the numbers.
• AVAILABILITY sheet is a dedicated “pegboard” view to track current/next commitments + confidence.

• Every row should have at least 1–3 source links.
• Use 'Last Verified' to track staleness; refresh anything older than ~90 days.
• Treat availability as probabilistic (use AvailabilityConf).

T0 = global event / tentpole proven; T1 = bankable studio event; T2 = established studio/prestige/genre; T3 = workman (reliable hired-gun, lane-specific); T4 = indie/specialty; T5 = emerging/breakout.
This version avoids rumor/hush-hush “politics” and only uses publicly reported info. Add internal intel in a separate private copy.
